brief:
An independent inquiry into British complicity in Israel's military operations in Gaza convened nearly a year ago under the leadership of former Labour MP Jeremy Corbyn, scholar Neve Gordon, and Palestinian activist Shahd Hammouri, Democracy Now! reported. The Gaza Tribunal operated as a nongovernmental tribunal to examine the United Kingdom's role in what organizers characterized as genocide against Palestinians.

The three co-chairs have continued to speak publicly about findings from the proceedings held in London. Their tribunal sought to document and assess British government actions and policies related to the conflict.

title: Corbyn, Gordon and Hammouri lead Gaza Tribunal investigating UK complicity
